text:
dara: Quick thread- Lumenix wants to increase to 50 seats. Procurement is asking for a staged acceptance: 6mo discounted pilot that auto-converts to 12mo. They want SE onboarding next week but need the acceptance path by EOD to hold the slot.
ben: What's the requested discount band for the pilot?
dara: Buyer asked for 20% off the 6mo pilot, then convert to list price. Finance already signaled concerns about churn on short pilots.
yasmin: Legal flagged signer authority: CFO is traveling. Can procurement sign or do we need a Delegation of Authority?
legal-bot: Guidance: delegated signer acceptable only with executed Delegation of Authority OR if PO explicitly names the delegated signer. Recommend a 1-page Delegation Addendum to speed execution.
kyle: From onboarding: we can run a condensed 3-day SE week if we lock dates now. SE slot is Apr 11-13. If we miss EOD, slot shifts 2 weeks. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
procurement-bot: Drafting PO template with delegated-signer field + vendor code KMS-77. ETA 90m.
dara: Customer prefers invoice split: 50% upfront for the pilot, remainder billed on conversion. Finance prefers full upfront.
finance: If we accept 50% upfront we need stronger conversion guarantee (card-on-file or automatic invoicing with vendor acceptance clause). Recommend card-on-file + auto-charge on conversion.
yasmin: Risk note - partial upfront reduces friction but increases admin. Recommend 50% upfront + card-on-file; include conversion billing mechanics in amendment.
kyle: Onboarding ok with 50% upfront + card-on-file, we can compress content to make SE effective.
dara: I'll send two options to buyer: (A) 6mo pilot @ -20% with 50% upfront, Delegation Addendum, SE week hold; (B) convert-now 12mo at list with full upfront and guaranteed SE.
ben: I'll update the quote and SOW and add a short billing paragraph about the automatic conversion charge and proration if needed.
procurement-bot: PO draft sent to dara@lumenix.com; included delegated signer checkbox and KMS-77 billing ref.
dara: Buyer replied: "Option A preferred but CFO signs Tue-Wed. Can you fast-track the delegation form and accept a PO scan if needed?"
yasmin: I'll prepare a Delegation Addendum and request an expedited internal review. Will include a sample signature block and a clause allowing PO scan + follow-up wet-sign if their bank requires it.
legal-bot: Addendum snippet: ```text
Delegation of Signature Authority \u2014 Organization X authorizes Person Y to sign Amendment for a defined period (dates), limited to X seats and the named amendment. Sample sign block and scope included.
```
dara: Checklist for enablement & billing: 1) tentatively hold SE Apr11-13 2) Delegation Addendum executed by Tue 3) PO uploaded + 50% payment processed 4) card-on-file captured or auto-invoice agreement 5) contingency: wet-sign route if bank requires (add 3 business days).
ben: pinging @finance for final approval on the 50% concession and card-on-file requirement. :pray:
procurement-bot: Noted. Will route PO to billing after addendum is uploaded. If buyer provides PO scan + named delegated signer we can proceed while awaiting wet signature.
kyle: I'll tentatively reserve SE team and prepare a condensed agenda and prework checklist to minimize live time.
dara: Thank you all. I'll send Option A with the Delegation Addendum and PO template to the buyer now and update here after execution. :thumbsup:
